caption: This drawing features an ornate, symmetrical composition dominated by gold and beige tones with accents of red, blue, and white. At the top of the image is an arched pediment decorated with swirling scrollwork, two seated human figures on either end, and a central golden urn. Below the urn, an eagle with outstretched wings is prominently positioned above a gold, leafy garland, just under the arch. Beneath the eagle, a blue and red shield or flag flutters, containing white stars. The central foreground displays three human figures: in the middle, a robed classical female figure (possibly representing Liberty or Columbia) stands atop a golden globe, while flanking her on either side are two male figures with feathered headgear and fur-like garments, each holding a staff. These two figures stand on decorative motifs shaped like cornucopias or leafy scrolls. In the background, a faded representation of the United States flag, with red and white stripes and blue fields, forms the backdrop for the central figures. The bottom features a scrolled banner with the words "UNITED STATES" in gold letters on a red background. The artwork is framed with gold accents and intricate detailing.
title: Panel from Circus Wagon
